title: flexitype event envelope
description: The wire envelope every flexitype event is delivered in — over a webhook, on the events feed, and through an external publisher. schema_version is bumped when this shape changes incompatibly, and the bump is called out in the changelog.

id.description: ULID of this envelope. Stable across redeliveries, so it is the key a consumer deduplicates on: delivery is at-least-once.

aggregate_id.description: The aggregate that EMITTED the event. For a value event this is the attribute value, not the entity — see entity_id.

type_definition_id.description: The type of the entity this event concerns. Present when the event concerns exactly one entity; absent for an event that concerns none (a schema change) or more than one (a relationship link, which names two endpoints).

entity_id.description: The entity this event concerns, so a router never has to decode the payload to learn what changed. Absent under the same rules as type_definition_id.

recorded_at.description: When the envelope was written. With the outbox these differ by the relay's latency.

payload.description: The event's own body. See payloads.schema.json.
